text.text_excerpt: I used this location for a catering order, and I was not disappointed. I used the online option to submit my order, which was super convenient. The order was ready by the time I requested, and I was in and out of the restaurant in 5-10 minutes. In addition to sandwiches, I also ordered a large salad and it came with a cute fire hydrant to hold the dressing. The sandwiches were tasty too- I ordered a platter of roast beef, turkey, ham, and veggie on either white or wheat bread (nothing too fancy). Overall, I was satisfied with this catering order and I would use them again. One thing to note was when I was picking up my order, I noticed that this location still does not do indoor dining. T...

YUMMMMMYYYYYYY!!! I ordered the veggie sub because I'm trying the trying this plant based lifestyle, and it was pretty filling. The veggies were cooked before placed on the sub, so I enjoyed every bite. There's a parking lot in front of the restaurant, so you won't have trouble finding a place to Park your car. I also love how they have firefighters' gear hanging up inside the restaurant. The decorations are cute! Unlike most sub places, you can't see the ingredients as the sandwiches are made.

Mmm, mmm, mmm. Wait, let me wipe my mouth. I just finished a philly steak and cheese sub. Finger-lickin', lip-smackin' good. I don't think I've ever tried the steak and cheese. I normally get their brisket sandwiches, whether the regular menu item or some limited-time version. I've also had the chicken, I think. It's a sandwich my wife normally gets. The steak and cheese sandwich had such a great flavor. I'm not sure if it was the brand of mayo or the combination of the mayo and peppers. And then the steak was chopped up nicely.
